title: Governance plan approval binding
$comment: Private file platform/governance/approval.yaml. A merged PR carrying this binding approves exactly one declaration content hash (sha256 of the reviewed platform/governance/repositories/platform.yaml bytes) and one plan digest; the governance executor applies that plan with no second operator command. Merging the approval PR keeps the declaration bytes identical, so the approval stays satisfiable; stale or mismatched bindings never apply. Workflow self-approval and release-App merge grants stay refused by module preconditions; unsupported prerequisites are reported, never auto-enabled.
